name: Golden Agri-Resources Ltd
summary: Golden Agri-Resources Ltd, an investment holding company, operates as an integrated palm oil plantation company in China, Indonesia, India, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Plantations and Palm Oil Mills; and Palm, Laurics and Others segments. It offers snacks and instant noodles; edible oils, such as sunflower, rice bran, mustard, groundnut, and palm olein; margarines, shortenings, sauces, and beverages; and specialty fats, as well as trades in, buys, and sells crude and refined palm olein, palm kernel, sunflower, and soybean oils.
